length-converter.quickAnswer: Type a value, pick the unit you have and the unit you want. The result appears instantly, computed with exact international conversion factors such as 1 inch = 2.54 cm and 1 mile = 1.609344 km.
keyFacts: The metre is the SI base unit of length, defined by the distance light travels in vacuum in 1/299,792,458 of a second.
One inch is defined as exactly 2.54 centimetres by international agreement (1959).
One mile equals exactly 1.609344 kilometres; one foot equals exactly 30.48 centimetres.
Metric prefixes scale by powers of ten: milli (1/1000), centi (1/100), kilo (1000).
The yard is exactly 0.9144 metres, and three feet make one yard.
howTo: Enter the numeric value you want to convert in the value field.
Choose the source unit from the "From" dropdown.
Choose the target unit from the "To" dropdown.
Read the converted result instantly; use the swap button to reverse the direction.
The line below the result shows the exact conversion rate used.
length-converter.formula:
result = value × (from-unit in metres) ÷ (to-unit in metres)
Example: 1 mile = 1609.344 m, so km = miles × 1609.344 ÷ 1000
length-converter.workedExample:
Convert 5 kilometres to miles.
Step 1: 5 km in metres = 5 × 1000 = 5000 m.
Step 2: 1 mile = 1609.344 m.
Step 3: 5000 ÷ 1609.344 = 3.106856.
Answer: 5 km = 3.106856 miles.
benefits: Covers the eight most-used metric and imperial length units in one tool.
Uses exact international definitions, not rounded approximations.
Instant results with no page reload and no data sent anywhere.
Swap button reverses the conversion in one tap.
Works offline-capable in the browser on any device.
limitations: Results are rounded to 6 decimal places for readability.
Extremely large or small scientific values (beyond 1e15) are clamped.
It converts units of length only; area and volume need their own converters.
Historical units (cubit, furlong variants) are not included.

faqs.q: How many centimetres are in an inch?
faqs.a: Exactly 2.54 cm. This value was fixed by the international yard-and-pound agreement of 1959, so it is exact, not an approximation.

faqs.q: How do I convert kilometres to miles?
faqs.a: Multiply kilometres by 0.621371, or divide by 1.609344. For example, 10 km × 0.621371 = 6.21371 miles.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a yard and a metre?
faqs.a: A yard is 0.9144 metres, so a metre is about 9.4% longer than a yard. Three feet make one yard.

faqs.q: Are the conversion factors used here exact?
faqs.a: Yes. The inch (2.54 cm), foot (0.3048 m), yard (0.9144 m) and mile (1609.344 m) are exact international definitions.

faqs.q: Can I convert feet and inches combined, like 5 ft 7 in?
faqs.a: Convert each part separately (5 ft to cm, 7 in to cm) and add the results. A combined feet+inches input is planned for a future update.

faqs.q: Is my data sent to a server?
faqs.a: No. Every calculation happens inside your browser; nothing you type ever leaves your device.
